name: Peach (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Peach (Prunus persica) [Fruits] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169928 (Peaches, raw, yellow) - full macro/sugar/amino-acid/vitamin/mineral/fatty-acid panel

Zhang et al. 2022, Foods, 'Physicochemical Characteristics, Antioxidant Activities, and Aroma Compound Analysis of Seven Peach Cultivars', PMC9563965 - individual sugars, sorbitol, and organic acids (malic/quinic/succinic/citric) by HPLC
Wang et al. 2022, 'Amino Acid Profiles in Peach (Prunus persica L.) Fruit', PMC9222846 - free amino-acid profile (asparagine dominant)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources: sucrose (~4.8 g/100g) plus glucose and fructose, with malic acid (~0.56 g/100g) the dominant organic acid and a major secondary substrate; succinic + quinic + citric complete the acid pool. The FooDB profile omitted ALL organic acids and sorbitol and lacked sugar/nutrient quantities - these are the key additions. Aspartate value (0.418 g) is inflated by asparagine, the dominant free amino acid and main reduced-N source. Organic-acid amounts are cultivar-variable (
curation_added: full USDA amino-acid, vitamin, mineral and fatty-acid quantities

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
